sources.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 — Benchmarks, Specs & Release Date
sources.snippet: What came before and after DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017? DeepSeek's previous tracked release was DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash on Sep 10 2026, 37 days earlier. It is the most recent DeepSeek model tracked on AI Release Tracker.

sources.title: DeepSeek Just Released V4.1-Flash-1017, Scores 77.0 on DeepSWE, Opens ...
sources.snippet: DeepSeek has just released DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, a new checkpoint of its V4.1-Flash model. It is live on the DeepSeek website, app and API. DeepSeek claims stronger scores, faster task completion and shorter outputs than the September V4.1-Flash release. The company calls it a Pareto improvement in performance and cost.

sources.title: DeepSeek Ties Its New V4.1-Flash-1017 Model Tighter to Its Own ...
sources.snippet: DeepSeek Ties Its New V4.1-Flash-1017 Model Tighter to Its Own Harness DeepSeek told users to upgrade to DeepSeek Harness v0.2.1-rc.1 for the best experience with the new model, which posted a 74.2% pass rate on Deep-SWE v1.1, edging out Opus-5's 74.0%. Tencent's CodeBuddy and WorkBuddy both get optimized access in the same announcement.

sources.title: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017: What's New in the Benchmark Update
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 raises coding and agentic benchmark scores over its predecessor while cutting task time and output length.
